title: TEA-Bench: A Systematic Benchmarking of Tool-enhanced Emotional Support Dialogue Agent
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the ability of tool-enhanced dialogue agents to provide emotional support in various scenarios, one of which is labeled 'Spirituality and faith'.
findings: The paper includes 'Spirituality and faith' as a category for emotional support scenarios. However, it does not provide a specific breakdown of model performance or any unique findings related to this category.
